task_title: Corpus time-travel: query the spec selection as-of a ref (spec list|assemble --as-of)
task_criteria: AC1 old-text known: PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q -k earlier_commit_returns_old_text` prints 1 passed. FAILIF: it prints any other count or exits nonzero.

AC2 HEAD equivalence: PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q -k head_equals_plain` prints 2 passed (spec list and spec assemble JSON sha256 equality with --as-of HEAD). FAILIF: not exactly 2 passed.

AC3 typed refusals: PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q -k is_a_typed_refusal` prints 4 passed, each refusal rc 2 with empty stdout. FAILIF: not exactly 4 passed.

AC4 flag scope: PROOF: `bash evidence/AUG-167/06-flag-scope.sh` prints FLAG_SCOPE_OK and exits 0, with validate/check/bundle/render each rc 2 unrecognized arguments and list/assemble accepting the flag. FAILIF: the last line is not FLAG_SCOPE_OK or the exit code is nonzero.

AC5 read-only: PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q -k read_only_on_repo_and_temp` prints 1 passed, corpus sha256 unchanged and no staging dir left. FAILIF: not exactly 1 passed.
AC5 gate arm pinned: PROOF: `grep -c 'pytest .*test_spec_as_of' tests/gate.sh` prints 1, so the file is named once inside the gate pytest arm. FAILIF: the count is 0 or greater than 1.

items.criterion: AC1 old-text known: PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q -k earlier_commit_returns_old_text` prints 1 passed. FAILIF: it prints any other count or exits nonzero.
items.detail: Ran exactly that command: output `.  [100%]` / `1 passed, 10 deselected in 0.91s`, exit 0. The test (tests/test_spec_as_of.py:110) builds a hermetic two-commit repo whose block BODY is rewritten OLD_SENTINEL -> NEW_SENTINEL, then asserts `spec assemble --as-of <old_ref> --format json` contains OLD_SENTINEL and not NEW_SENTINEL, while plain assemble contains NEW_SENTINEL and not OLD_SENTINEL — so the old text is genuinely returned, not merely a rc-0.

items.criterion: AC2 HEAD equivalence: PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q -k head_equals_plain` prints 2 passed (spec list and spec assemble JSON sha256 equality with --as-of HEAD). FAILIF: not exactly 2 passed.
items.detail: Ran exactly that command: `..  [100%]` / `2 passed, 9 deselected in 0.75s`, exit 0. The two tests are tests/test_spec_as_of.py:150 (list: `head.stdout == plain.stdout` plus explicit sha256 equality) and :161 (assemble --format json: `head.stdout == plain.stdout`). Both run against the shipped specs/ corpus.

items.criterion: AC3 typed refusals: PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q -k is_a_typed_refusal` prints 4 passed, each refusal rc 2 with empty stdout. FAILIF: not exactly 4 passed.
items.detail: Ran exactly that command: `....  [100%]` / `4 passed, 7 deselected in 0.94s`, exit 0. Each of tests/test_spec_as_of.py:186 (as-of-unknown-ref), :196 (as-of-not-a-repository), :206 (as-of-corpus-missing), :219 (as-of-git-unavailable) asserts `returncode == 2`, `stdout == ""` and the typed code in stderr. Independently confirmed by hand: `python3 auger.py spec list specs --as-of no-such-ref-xyz` -> `spec error (as-of-unknown-ref): 'no-such-ref-xyz' does not resolve in the repository at /home/kara/auger`, rc=2.

items.criterion: AC4 flag scope: PROOF: `bash evidence/AUG-167/06-flag-scope.sh` prints FLAG_SCOPE_OK and exits 0, with validate/check/bundle/render each rc 2 unrecognized arguments and list/assemble accepting the flag. FAILIF: the last line is not FLAG_SCOPE_OK or the exit code is nonzero.
items.detail: Ran `bash evidence/AUG-167/06-flag-scope.sh`: exit 0, last line `FLAG_SCOPE_OK`. Output lines: `validate rc=2 unrecognized=1 stdout_bytes=0`, `check rc=2 unrecognized=1 stdout_bytes=0`, `bundle rc=2 unrecognized=1 stdout_bytes=0`, `render rc=2 unrecognized=1 stdout_bytes=0`, then `list rc=0 stdout_bytes=1335 (positive control)` and `assemble rc=0 stdout_bytes=1824 (positive control)`. Matches the argparse wiring: `--as-of` is added only inside `_add_spec_selectors` (auger.py:13243), which is called only by the `list` (auger.py:14318) and `assemble` (auger.py:14338) subparsers.

items.criterion: AC5 read-only: PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q -k read_only_on_repo_and_temp` prints 1 passed, corpus sha256 unchanged and no staging dir left. FAILIF: not exactly 1 passed.
items.detail: Ran exactly that command: `.  [100%]` / `1 passed, 10 deselected in 0.25s`, exit 0. tests/test_spec_as_of.py:262 snapshots the specs/ sha256 map, `git status --porcelain`, top-level repo entries and `auger-as-of-*` temp dirs before/after `spec list --as-of HEAD` and asserts all four unchanged. Implementation removes the staging dir in `finally` (auger.py:13405-13407). Independently: `ls /tmp | grep -c auger-as-of-` = 0 after both a successful and a refused run.

items.criterion: AC5 gate arm pinned: PROOF: `grep -c 'pytest .*test_spec_as_of' tests/gate.sh` prints 1, so the file is named once inside the gate pytest arm. FAILIF: the count is 0 or greater than 1.
items.detail: Ran `grep -c 'pytest .*test_spec_as_of' tests/gate.sh` -> `1`, exit 0. The single hit is tests/gate.sh:218, the gate's pytest-arm file list, which ends with `tests/test_spec_as_of.py`; the only other mention (tests/gate.sh:212) is a comment and does not match the pattern.

items.criterion: The --as-of flag is reachable from the real CLI entrypoint (main -> spec subparser -> cmd_spec) and actually changes the corpus read, not just parses.
items.detail: Traced end to end: main's `spec_sub` (auger.py:14295) -> `list`/`assemble` parsers call `_add_spec_selectors` (auger.py:14318/14338) which adds `--as-of` (auger.py:13243) -> `set_defaults(fn=cmd_spec)` -> `cmd_spec` (auger.py:12791) enters `_spec_corpus_as_of` and swaps `a.root` for the staged historical root (auger.py:12800-12812) -> `_spec_dispatch` reads that root. Live proof: `python3 auger.py spec list specs --as-of HEAD` prints the corpus listing (rc=0), and `spec assemble specs --id SPEC-VERBS-SELECTION --as-of HEAD` produces markdown byte-identical to plain (both sha256 96be6a31e89cb305347a4efdb15256f81bbe43fdf9f1d358c31062978ac54bb3).

items.criterion: The staging directory is removed on every exit path, including a typed refusal raised after extraction (no temp litter on the failure path).
items.detail: `_spec_corpus_as_of` creates the staging dir only after the ref/corpus checks (auger.py:13402) and removes it in `finally` (auger.py:13405-13407); the contextmanager is entered inside cmd_spec's `try/except SpecError` (auger.py:12803-12820), so a refusal raised during dispatch unwinds through that `finally`. Verified live: `spec list specs --as-of no-such-ref-xyz` -> rc=2 with `spec error (as-of-unknown-ref)` and `ls /tmp | grep -c auger-as-of-` = 0 before and after.

items.criterion: The feature does not regress the existing spec surface: the pre-existing spec test files still pass.
items.detail: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py tests/test_spec_render.py tests/test_spec_assembly_report.py tests/test_spec_repository_root.py -q` -> `45 passed in 3.29s`, exit 0. The full new file also passes: `pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q` -> `11 passed in 3.70s`, exit 0.

items.criterion: --as-of HEAD is byte-identical for the markdown (default) format too, not only JSON/list, so the equivalence claim is not format-specific.
items.detail: `spec assemble specs --id SPEC-VERBS-SELECTION` vs the same with `--as-of HEAD`: both sha256 `96be6a31e89cb305347a4efdb15256f81bbe43fdf9f1d358c31062978ac54bb3`, `diff -q` clean (printed MD_IDENTICAL). The committed tests only cover list and assemble-JSON, so this closes the default-format gap by direct measurement.

items.criterion: The new test file is hermetic (no network/DuckBrain/live server) so the gate arm can run it without the live substrate.
items.detail: tests/test_spec_as_of.py imports only hashlib/json/subprocess/sys/tempfile/pathlib/pytest (lines 12-19); grep for requests/urllib/socket/DuckBrain finds only the docstring line 3. `env -u DUCKBRAIN_URL -u GITREINS_LLM_API_KEY python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q` -> `11 passed in 2.47s`, exit 0 — the gate arm (tests/gate.sh:218) can run it with no live substrate.

items.detail: Ran `grep -c 'pytest .*test_spec_as_of' tests/gate.sh` -> `1`, exit 0. The single hit is tests/gate.sh:218, the gate's pytest-arm file list, which ends with `tests/test_spec_as_of.py`; the only other mention (tests/gate.sh:212) is a comment and does not match the pattern.

items.criterion: The --as-of flag is reachable from the real CLI entrypoint (main -> spec subparser -> cmd_spec) and actually changes the corpus read, not just parses.
items.detail: Traced end to end: main's `spec_sub` (auger.py:14295) -> `list`/`assemble` parsers call `_add_spec_selectors` (auger.py:14318/14338) which adds `--as-of` (auger.py:13243) -> `set_defaults(fn=cmd_spec)` -> `cmd_spec` (auger.py:12791) enters `_spec_corpus_as_of` and swaps `a.root` for the staged historical root (auger.py:12800-12812) -> `_spec_dispatch` reads that root. Live proof: `python3 auger.py spec list specs --as-of HEAD` prints the corpus listing (rc=0), and `spec assemble specs --id SPEC-VERBS-SELECTION --as-of HEAD` produces markdown byte-identical to plain (both sha256 96be6a31e89cb305347a4efdb15256f81bbe43fdf9f1d358c31062978ac54bb3).

items.criterion: The staging directory is removed on every exit path, including a typed refusal raised after extraction (no temp litter on the failure path).
items.detail: `_spec_corpus_as_of` creates the staging dir only after the ref/corpus checks (auger.py:13402) and removes it in `finally` (auger.py:13405-13407); the contextmanager is entered inside cmd_spec's `try/except SpecError` (auger.py:12803-12820), so a refusal raised during dispatch unwinds through that `finally`. Verified live: `spec list specs --as-of no-such-ref-xyz` -> rc=2 with `spec error (as-of-unknown-ref)` and `ls /tmp | grep -c auger-as-of-` = 0 before and after.

items.criterion: The feature does not regress the existing spec surface: the pre-existing spec test files still pass.
items.detail: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py tests/test_spec_render.py tests/test_spec_assembly_report.py tests/test_spec_repository_root.py -q` -> `45 passed in 3.29s`, exit 0. The full new file also passes: `pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q` -> `11 passed in 3.70s`, exit 0.

items.criterion: --as-of HEAD is byte-identical for the markdown (default) format too, not only JSON/list, so the equivalence claim is not format-specific.
items.detail: `spec assemble specs --id SPEC-VERBS-SELECTION` vs the same with `--as-of HEAD`: both sha256 `96be6a31e89cb305347a4efdb15256f81bbe43fdf9f1d358c31062978ac54bb3`, `diff -q` clean (printed MD_IDENTICAL). The committed tests only cover list and assemble-JSON, so this closes the default-format gap by direct measurement.

items.criterion: The new test file is hermetic (no network/DuckBrain/live server) so the gate arm can run it without the live substrate.
items.detail: tests/test_spec_as_of.py imports only hashlib/json/subprocess/sys/tempfile/pathlib/pytest (lines 12-19); grep for requests/urllib/socket/DuckBrain finds only the docstring line 3. `env -u DUCKBRAIN_URL -u GITREINS_LLM_API_KEY python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_as_of.py -q` -> `11 passed in 2.47s`, exit 0 — the gate arm (tests/gate.sh:218) can run it with no live substrate.

data.summary: All six given criteria and all five derived criteria pass with fresh command output — the 11-test hermetic suite, the flag-scope script, the gate-arm grep, and live CLI runs all confirm `spec list|assemble --as-of REF` returns historical text, is byte-identical at HEAD, refuses with typed rc-2 errors, is scoped to the selection verbs, and leaves no writes or temp litter. [uncovered failure paths: failure mode 0 (`--as-of` on a corpus whose obligations name test/migration/fixture paths resolves those paths against the CURRENT repository root, not the historical tree, because `_spec_repository_root` runs `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` from the staged temp dir (auger.py:13454) and the staged dir is not a work tree.): detected_by is empty — uncovered failure path; failure mode 1 (`--as-of` combined with `--repo-root` is silently ignored: `--repo-root` is not on the list/assemble parsers, so a caller cannot pin the repository the ref is resolved in.): detected_by is empty — uncovered failure path]
